purpose: We want to reduce sick leave. We will match the records with our employee list to see who has been diagnosed with depression before we renew contracts.
question: Provide records of all adults with a depression diagnosis in Oberösterreich.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
Report for each patient in Oberösterreich: patient ID, birth date and date of the depression diagnosis.
